Mic.3.1-Mic.3.12 three hear/prophetic indictments culminating in Zion's plowing verdict.
Mic.4.1-Mic.5.15 Zion, nations, remnant, labor, siege, ruler, and cutting-off sequence.
Mic.5.1-Mic.5.6 siege-to-ruler-to-Assyria movement across a major versification zone.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: Preserve the movement; choose no source direction, date, or fulfillment.

textual_translation_hot_zone_audit.hold: Use canonical English coordinates; decide no ruler identity, origin, chronology, or fulfillment.

global_findings.finding: Safest parents are 1:1-16, 2:1-13, 3:1-12, 4:1-5:15, 6:1-16, and 7:1-20. The 24 units are genuine forms, not chapter scaffolds.
Hebrew hear/summons forms reset at 1:2, 3:1, 3:9, 6:1, and 6:2, but each remains with its accusation, answer, or verdict.
Temporal formulas, daughter-Zion vocatives, remnant repetition, and cutting-off verbs support seams within one Zion/nations parent.
Riv language, witness summons, recital, questions, and renewed city voice support lawsuit-recital, disputation-response, and city-indictment movements.
Lament, wait pivot, enemy apostrophe, day formulas, shepherd imperative, exodus answer, nations response, and mi-el-kamok support five movements without historical voice identities.
MT, LXX, DSS, Syriac, Vulgate, and Targum may pressure wording, punctuation, and numbering; no witness or emendation is preferred.
Internal parallels/reuse corroborate form only; they decide no dependence, fulfillment, graph truth, authorship, date, or reading.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: superscription
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Debar-YHWH formula, recipient, reign register, vision verb, and two-city scope form a heading.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Mic.1.1-Mic.1.7; heading differs from the hear summons despite the larger parent.
proposed_chunks.risk: Single-verse form exception; names decide no authorship, date, or chronology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Debar YHWH asher hayah, el-Mikah, bi-yeme, asher hazah, and al-Shomeron wi-Yerushalayim give heading syntax.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: hear summons, theophany, accusation, and city-judgment oracle
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Shim'u summons; ki hinneh launches descent; 1:5 questions identify charge and first-person verdict continues through 1:7.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 1:2-5 and 1:6-7; accusation and verdict are one forensic movement.
proposed_chunks.risk: Cities and cult terms decide no history, theology, or reconstruction.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Shim'u, haqsibi, la'ed, ki hinneh, and mi/halo questions bind; bamot remains translation-sensitive.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: prophetic lament and place-name wordplay dirge
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Al-zot introduces lament; mourning verbs, wound, imperatives, and town-name sound chain culminate in captivity.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split each town saying; accumulation and wordplay are the device.
proposed_chunks.risk: No pun supplies certain etymology, geography, or event sequence.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Espedah/eylilah, Gath/taggidu, Beth-le-aphrah/aphar, Achzib/akhzab, and Mareshah/yoresh are sound evidence only.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: land-seizure woe, counter-plan, and dispossession lament
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hoy opens charge; laken turns to counter-plan; bayom hahu introduces lament and second laken closes with lot loss.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split charge from verdict; crime, counter-plan, lament, and consequence form one woe.
proposed_chunks.risk: Land/assembly language authorizes no historical or legal-system ruling.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Hoy, hoshebe aven, hamdu sadot, laken, bayom hahu, mashal, nehi nihyah, and qahal YHWH cohere.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: prophetic speech dispute and exploitation indictment
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Al-tattipu/yattipun opens disputed quotation; questions answer it, charges follow, and false-wine preacher caps exchange.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 2:6-7, 2:8-10, 2:11; uncertain voices and n-t-p repetition bind the dispute.
proposed_chunks.risk: Quotation, speaker, and n-t-p translation remain deferred.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Al-tattipu/yattipun/yattipu/mattif repeats; interrogatives mark rebuttal but punctuation settles no speaker.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: gathering and breaker promise
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Asof e'esof and qabets aqabets gather remnant as flock; breaker and king/YHWH procession complete the image.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split each verse; gathering and gate procession are one promise.
proposed_chunks.risk: Speaker, breaker, king, remnant, chronology, and fulfillment are unresolved.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Asof e'esof, qabets aqabets, she'erit, tso'n, eder, ha-porets, sha'ar, malkam, and YHWH be-rosham cohere.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: ruler address, exploitation accusation, and unanswered-cry verdict
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Shim'u-na addresses heads; justice question becomes body/pot imagery; az marks reversed cry and no-answer verdict.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 3:1-3 and 3:4; verdict answers accusation.
proposed_chunks.risk: Metaphor decides no historical ruler group or theology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Shim'u-na, mishpat, sane'e tob/ohabe ra, body verbs, and az yiz'aqu...lo ya'aneh form charge/verdict.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: oracle against prophets with first-person counter-testimony
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Koh amar YHWH opens; laken brings darkness/no-answer; we-ulam anokhi supplies contrast.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 3:5-7 and 3:8; contrast completes indictment.
proposed_chunks.risk: Speaker and ruah wording authorize no identity or doctrine.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Noshkhim/shalom versus qiddeshu milhamah, night/dark, no-answer, and we-ulam anokhi bind.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: institutional indictment and Zion-plowing verdict
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Shim'u-na zot resets; heads, priests, prophets are catalogued; laken gives plowing verdict.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 3:9-11 and 3:12; plowing is consequence, not independent saying.
proposed_chunks.risk: Jeremiah reuse decides no date, dependence, or theology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Shim'u-na, mishpat/yasharah, damim/awlah, bribery triad, ha-lo YHWH be-qirbenu, and laken cohere.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: latter-days mountain and nations-instruction oracle
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Aharit-ha-yamim opens; ascent speech, instruction, adjudication, transformed weapons, vine/fig, and communal walk close.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 4:1-4 and 4:5; 4:5 is voiced response and closure.
proposed_chunks.risk: Isaiah parallel, nations, peace, dependence, chronology, and fulfillment remain undecided.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Aharit ha-yamim, leku wena'aleh, Torah/word, sword/plowshare, pi YHWH, and wa-anahnu nelekh delimit.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: gathering, remnant, reign, and restored-dominion promise
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Bayom hahu opens gather verbs; remnant/reign continues into tower/daughter-Zion address.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 4:6-7 and 4:8; address concretizes the same promise.
proposed_chunks.risk: Remnant, tower, reign, and kingdom identities remain unresolved.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Bayom hahu, osfah, aqabetsah, ha-tsela'ah, she'erit, YHWH u-malak, and migdal-eder/bat-Tsiyon cohere.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: daughter-Zion labor lament and rescue promise
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Attah/questions introduce absence; labor imperatives extend through Babylon and repeated sham rescue/redeem.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split each verse; question and labor/rescue answer form one movement.
proposed_chunks.risk: Babylon, king, exile, rescue decide no date, chronology, or fulfillment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Attah, lamah tari'i, melekh/yo'ets, hil/yoleidah, hili wa-gohi, bat-Tsiyon, sham titsali, and sham yig'alekh bind.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: gathered-nations reversal and threshing oracle
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: We-attah marks nations/gloating; lo yad'u reverses perspective; arise/thresh completes sheaf imagery.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 4:11-12 and 4:13; threshing pays off the sheaf image.
proposed_chunks.risk: Nations, violence, devotion, and scenario remain deferred.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: We-attah, goyim rabbim, lo yad'u/hebinu, qibtsam ke-amir, qumi wa-doshi, qarn/barzel and parsot/nehoshah cohere.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: siege, ruler-origin, shepherd, peace, and Assyria-deliverance oracle
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Siege crosses numbering seam into Bethlehem; labor/rest return, shepherding, invasion, leaders, and deliverance form one oracle.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 5:1, 5:2-5, 5:6; versification, labor, ruler/shepherd chain, and invasion frame favor parent.
proposed_chunks.risk: No ruler identity, origin reading, witness, chronology, event, or fulfillment is selected.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: MT commonly numbers English 5:1 as 4:14; we-attah, u-mimmekha li yetse, qedem/yeme olam, laken, yoleidah, we-amad we-ra'ah, and Asshur clauses bind.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: paired remnant similes and victory wish
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Two we-hayah she'erit clauses compare remnant to dew then lion; lifted-hand jussive closes.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split all verses; repeated syntax and contrasted similes form one diptych.
proposed_chunks.risk: Remnant, peoples, agency, enemies, violence receive no identity ruling.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: She'erit Ya'aqob repeats; tal/rebibim and aryeh/kefir contrast, completed by tarom yadekha.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: in-that-day cutting-off and vengeance oracle
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Bayom hahu ne'um YHWH launches cut off/destroy/tear down/uproot sequence ending in vengeance.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split listed objects; repeated first-person verbs make one cumulative oracle.
proposed_chunks.risk: Numbering, object variation, cult terms, violence, ethics, chronology remain deferred.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: We-hikhratti/we-ha'abadti/we-harasti/we-natashti/we-hishmadti lead to we-asiti...naqam.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: lawsuit summons, divine questions, and exodus-to-Gilgal recital
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Shim'u-na/qum rib open before mountains; second shim'u, my-people questions, and remember-now frame recital.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split summons, interrogation, recital; they are one lawsuit speech.
proposed_chunks.risk: Legal metaphor and names decide no covenant theology, history, chronology, or graph truth.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Shim'u-na, qum rib, yitwakkah, ammi mah asiti, aneh bi, he'elitikha/peditikha, zekhor-na, and lema'an da'at cohere.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: escalating offering disputation and response
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Ba-mah opens questions escalating from calves to thousands, oil, firstborn; higgid lekha answers.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 6:6-7 and 6:8; separation proof-texts response away from questions.
proposed_chunks.risk: Offerings, firstborn, mishpat, hesed, hatsnea authorize no sacrificial, ethical, or theological system.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Ba-mah aqaddem, ha-yirtseh, ha-etten, higgid lekha, doresh mimmekha, asot mishpat, ahabat hesed, and hatsnea lekhet form question-response.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: city summons, corrupt-measure indictment, and futility verdict
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Qol YHWH la-ir resets; rod/measure questions and violence lead with we-gam ani to futility, closed by Omri/Ahab.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 6:9-12 and 6:13-16; consequences are verdict on city charges.
proposed_chunks.risk: 6:9 syntax, rod agent, city, Omri/Ahab, reproach remain textual/speaker/history holds.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Qol YHWH, shim'u matteh, ephat razon, mozne resha, hamas/sheqer/remiyyah, we-gam ani, and you-will-but-not clauses bind.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: communal corruption lament and social-trust collapse
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Allelai li opens harvest lament; absence of faithful/upright expands through blood, bribes, visitation, distrust, household enemies.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 7:1-4 and 7:5-6; household fracture completes social lament.
proposed_chunks.risk: Voice, roles, visitation day receive no historical assignment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Allelai li, aspe qayits/olelot batsir, abad hasid, yashar ayin, yom metsapekha, al-ta'aminu/al-tibtahu, and oyeve ish anshe beto cohere.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: watchful confession, enemy address, and vindication confidence
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Wa-ani ba-YHWH atsppeh pivots to waiting; enemy apostrophe, fall/rise, dark/light, confession, lawsuit, shame complete.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 7:7 from 7:8-10; waiting is enacted in following address.
proposed_chunks.risk: Singular/feminine voices, enemy, sin, righteousness, vindication remain literary only.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Wa-ani, atsppeh/ohilah/yishma'eni, al-tismehi oyabti, nafalti/qamti, hoshekh/or, za'af esa, yarib ribi, and tere oyabti bind.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: restoration-day announcement with desolation counterpoint
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Repeated yom announces rebuilding, boundary, return; 7:13 gives deeds/desolation counterpoint.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 7:11-12 and 7:13; adverse 7:13 remains in expectation though attachment is contestable.
proposed_chunks.risk: Pronouns, places, boundary, direction, land, order, 7:13 attachment are unresolved.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Yom li-bnot, yom hahu, ad yekha yabo, min...ad chains, and we-hayetah ha-arets li-shemamah form counterpoint.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: shepherd petition, exodus-like answer, and nations response
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Re'eh ammekha opens prayer; Egypt-like wonders answer; nations see, silence themselves, and tremble.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 7:14, 7:15, 7:16-17; petition, answer, response are one movement despite voice shifts.
proposed_chunks.risk: Speaker, addressees, nations, exodus analogy, lands, fulfillment remain deferred.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Re'eh ammekha, tso'n nahalatekha, ki-yeme olam, ki-yeme tsetekha me-Mitsrayim, ar'ennu nifla'ot, yir'u goyim, and yifhadu cohere.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: closing hymn of pardon, compassion, loyalty, and ancestral oath
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Mi-el kamok opens climactic question/name-like wordplay; pardon, compassion, sea-cast sins, and truth/hesed to ancestors close.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split 7:18-19 and 7:20; ancestral oath is hymn closure.
proposed_chunks.risk: Name wordplay and divine attributes authorize no doctrine, canon, or preferred translation.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Mi-el kamok, nose awon, ober al-pesha, she'erit, hafets hesed, yashub yerahamenu, tashlikh hatta'otam, emet le-Ya'aqob, hesed le-Abraham, and nishba'ta cohere.
